newsitem.title: UK: Kingfisher rebounds on German bid denial.
newsitem.headline: Kingfisher rebounds on German bid denial.

text.p: Shares in British retail group Kingfisher Plc recovered their early losses on Monday after German do-it-yourself chain Hornbach Baumarkt AG said there was no basis to talk that Kingfisher might buy it.
Earlier, a report in the Mail on Sunday newspaper that Kingfisher was poised to buy Hornbach for 400 million stg had hit shares in the British company.
"People were slightly worried a big takeover would have stretched (Kingfisher) and could have led to a rights issue," one market-maker said.
Kingfisher shares were up 11p to 692-1/2 by 1213 GMT, having been as low as 671 early in the session.
The Hornbach family owns most of the shares in the German chain and any takeover would require their agreement.
